title: Step-Up SIP Accelerator Benefit
summary: Automate annual 10%–15% SIP increments across core Large, Flexi, and Mid-Cap mutual funds with complimentary annual rebalancing.
details: Designed for salaried professionals and growing families whose income rises year over year. By pairing automated annual SIP step-ups with disciplined asset-class rebalancing, investors capture higher long-term rupee-cost averaging without timing the market. Includes a structured yearly goal-progress review at no additional advisory setup charge.
eligibility: New & existing SIP investors committing a minimum 3-year horizon
highlights: Automatic 10% or 15% annual SIP top-up configuration
Complimentary yearly portfolio overlap & drift review
Flexible pause or modification option anytime without penalty

title: ELSS Tax-Shield Dual Benefit
summary: Combine Section 80C tax deductions (up to ₹1.5 Lakh) with diversified equity compounding and the shortest 3-year statutory lock-in.
details: Equity Linked Savings Schemes (ELSS) offer one of the shortest lock-in periods among Section 80C instruments while maintaining long-term equity growth potential. Our curated ELSS framework filters funds on rolling 5-year consistency, downside capture, and portfolio overlap so your tax-saving allocation strengthens your core equity sleeve.
eligibility: Resident individuals & HUFs opting for Old Tax Regime deductions
highlights: Up to ₹1,50,000 deduction eligibility under Section 80C
Shortest 3-year lock-in compared to PPF (15 yrs) or Tax FDs (5 yrs)
Instant digital tax-proof statement for employer payroll filing

title: Multi-Asset Gold & Debt Cushion Policy
summary: Core advisory policy allocating across Indian equities, sovereign debt, and Gold/Silver ETFs to dampen severe market drawdowns.
details: Under our institutional multi-asset policy, conservative and milestone-sensitive portfolios are structured with non-correlated hedges across domestic equity, high-grade debt, and precious metal ETFs. Periodic threshold rebalancing trims outperforming assets and redeploys into undervalued sleeves automatically.
eligibility: Families, retirees & business owners prioritizing capital stability
highlights: Built-in Gold/Silver hedge against inflation & currency volatility
Automatic threshold rebalancing without emotional timing
Lower portfolio volatility across sharp market corrections

title: Corporate Treasury T+1 Liquidity Advantage
summary: Deploy idle business reserves into AAA-rated Liquid, Overnight, and Arbitrage mutual funds with T+1 bank credit and zero lock-in.
details: Businesses holding operational surpluses in zero- or low-interest current accounts lose purchasing power daily. Our Treasury Desk structures a tiered liquidity ladder across Overnight, Liquid, and Arbitrage mutual funds—preserving principal safety while improving post-tax treasury yields.
eligibility: Private limited companies, LLPs, partnerships & family trusts
highlights: Redemption proceeds credited on T+1 working day
Strict AAA / Sovereign credit-quality screening policy
Arbitrage option for equity-like taxation on >12 month holds

title: Complimentary Portfolio Overlap & Exit-Load Audit
summary: Consolidate fragmented 15–25 scheme portfolios into a high-conviction 5–7 fund architecture while minimizing exit-load and STCG drag.
details: Many investors accumulate overlapping mutual funds over the years, resulting in index-hugging returns and high expense ratios. Our complimentary audit maps stock-level overlap, exit-load windows, and capital-gains impact to design a phased tax-smart transition plan.
eligibility: Existing mutual fund investors with portfolios above ₹5 Lakhs
highlights: Phased switch schedule to avoid short-term capital gains tax
Clear consolidation blueprint within 5 working days

title: Tax-Smart Retirement SWP Income Policy
summary: Generate predictable monthly cashflows via Systematic Withdrawal Plans (SWP) with a 24-month liquid buffer protecting equity principal.
details: Traditional fixed deposits tax entire interest earnings at slab rates. Under our Bucket-SWP Policy, 24 months of living expenses sit in ultra-safe liquid/arbitrage funds while the remaining corpus compounds in hybrid and equity funds—taxing only the capital-gains portion of each withdrawal.
eligibility: Retirees, senior citizens & financially independent households
highlights: Dedicated 2-year cashflow buffer against bear-market sequence risk
Only gains component taxed on monthly SWP withdrawals
Automated monthly credit directly to primary bank account
